protocol.gate: Retain model-bound evidence only if confirmed Speed-error responses and all factual-error responses do not increase over the 30 matched baseline outputs, and no two cases each lose >=2 core explanations. No general accuracy or significance claim. Retain verified rounding/missing-stat fixes independently.
protocol.limitations: Historical baseline reused; sequential nonblinded manual review, not randomized. Instructions and source requests frozen. Conditional numbers are assumptions, not observed field states.

decisionNote: The necessary nonregression guard passed, but Speed-error responses did not improve, concerns increased, core explanations slightly declined and observed latency worsened. Do not claim a causal regression or a proven accuracy gain. Remove the experimental runtime table and its dedicated tests.
